create_agent_from_opt: create a ParlAI agent from options dict using create_agent with model and model_file arguments
load_agent_from_model_file: load a ParlAI agent from a saved model file using create_agent_from_model_file with opt_overrides
respond_with_agent: get a text response from a ParlAI agent by calling respond with a message string
batch_respond_with_agent: get batch text responses from a ParlAI agent by calling batch_respond with a list of messages
clone_and_share_agent: clone a ParlAI agent and create shared copies using share and create_agent_from_shared for parallelism
